title: Add epistemic doctrine to the opum-lore skill: status is not a verdict, bounded retrieval is advisory
description:
Two doctrine additions to skills/lore/SKILL.md (the public opum-lore plugin skill), proposed by opum-agent after extracting transferable guidance from the condorcet-research skill on mbpm2 rather than porting that skill itself (user-approved). Source: OPAG-121/OPAG-122 context, same 2026-09-13 proof-graph inspection that produced LCLI-476 through 479.

1. A document's status/attribution/task-completion is not a verdict about its content -- status: stable names a lifecycle stage, verified attribution names who touched it, neither substitutes for checking the claim's own evidence.
2. Bounded retrieval as usage guidance: retrieve a bounded navigation view and read exact sources before writing, rather than pulling whole targets; --max-tokens is advisory today, not a hard ceiling (lore context can return a target larger than the budget, marked truncated) -- this is LCLI-478's subject, document current behavior now and tighten wording once 478 lands.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/lore/SKILL.md states plainly that status/attribution/Done reflect lifecycle, not correctness, in the skill's own voice/format
skills/lore/SKILL.md documents that --max-tokens is advisory (not enforced) and recommends bounded navigation + exact-source reads over pulling whole targets
Wording is scoped to note current behavior, not to promise a hard budget that does not yet exist (revisit once LCLI-478 lands)

implementationNotes: Both doctrine additions written into skills/lore/SKILL.md under a new '## Read the evidence, not the status label' section (status/attribution/Done is lifecycle not correctness; bounded retrieval + --max-tokens is advisory today, revisit wording once LCLI-478 lands). Committed on branch docs/LCLI-480-skill-epistemic-doctrine, not yet merged -- this task record lives only on that branch until the PR lands, same as LCLI-473/475's precedent. Session recycled for context budget mid-release-work on an unrelated task (LCLI-475's 0.6.1 publish); picking this back up just needs opening/landing the PR, no further authoring.

Paused (not blocked on anything real) so the tracker has exactly one In Progress task during a session handoff -- the flush script that writes the handoff note only fires with exactly one. All work is done: PR #12 (docs/LCLI-480-skill-epistemic-doctrine -> dev) is open with both commits, all 3 acceptance criteria checked. Nothing left but review/merge. Resume with `quest task start LCLI-480` once picked back up, or just merge #12 and close it directly.
finalSummary:
DELIVERED in PR #12 (docs/LCLI-480-skill-epistemic-doctrine -> dev). All three acceptance criteria are checked against the landed text, not against intent: skills/lore/SKILL.md now carries a "## Read the evidence, not the status label" section (line 71) saying that status/attribution/Done name a lifecycle stage rather than a verdict on content, and that bounded navigation plus exact-source reads beat pulling whole targets because --max-tokens is advisory today -- a target larger than the budget is returned marked truncated, not refused. AC#3's scoping holds: the wording describes current behavior and does not promise a hard ceiling, so it needs revisiting only when LCLI-478 actually lands.

WHAT DELAYED THIS WAS NOT THE WORK. Authoring finished 2026-09-13; the PR then sat parked through the 0.6.1 release, LCLI-487 and LCLI-488, and went CONFLICTING at 2026-09-14T03:53Z purely as collateral from dev moving to a11223a7 underneath it. The task's "Blocked" status was likewise an artifact of a handoff convention (exactly one In Progress task at flush time), not a real blocker -- worth knowing, because a future reader would otherwise take the label as a finding about the content. That is the same confusion this task's own doctrine warns about.

CONFLICT RESOLUTION, recorded because the discarded side was not empty. Resolved by merging dev into the branch (9cefd3ab), not rebasing, so no force-push was needed. Two conflicts, neither in the skill tree:
- .quest/tasks/LCLI-475.json, modify/delete: dev completed LCLI-475 and relocated it to .quest/completed/, while this branch was still appending in-progress notes to the old path. Took dev's deletion. The four branch-only implementationNotes were diffed against dev's completed record first -- all were pre-release session cursors ("parked waiting on the user", the publish-script failure) that the completed record's finalSummary and LCLI-482's OIDC root cause already supersede. Nothing dev lacks was lost.
- docs/log.md: took dev's side, a strict superset of the branch's single added line.
